intro: Drag the sliders. Watch a ball roll downhill on a toy error curve.

steps.explanation: The ball starts where you place it, high on the slope with a large error.
steps.label: Begin on the hillside

steps.explanation: Each tap moves the ball against the slope by your chosen step size.
steps.label: Roll a little downhill

steps.explanation: Small steps creep safely down; large steps bounce across the valley.
steps.label: Feel the step size

takeaways: Small steps are slow but safe; big steps can overshoot.
The error drops fast at first, then flattens near the bottom.
Repeating measure-and-step is the whole trick behind learning.
title: Roll downhill with your own step size
